feature_status: Immersion engine implemented for ready visual packs; expanded roster asset slots remain incoming.

rules.missing_sprite: Use primary portrait or neutral sprite when available; never fail chat creation.
rules.missing_background: Use a compatible ready background or Protean default; later dynamic BackgroundResolver may provide a remote URL.
rules.model_asset_authority: Models may emit semantic presentation state only. They must never emit or choose raw file paths.
rules.timeline_authority: Asset availability never changes timeline knowledge, scenario, tone, or character state.
rules.open_slots: Incoming slots remain declared in this manifest so later patches can fill them without changing IDs.
rules.eligibility: Immersion is offered only when the selected character/timeline has a ready sprite pack and a ready default background. Diary Tom uses a diary-first render mode even though his age-reference sprite pack is ready.
rules.session_lock: Timeline, scenario, and tone are frozen by the chat created at Immersion entry. The Immersion page exposes no controls that mutate them.
rules.presentation_handler: The Immersion handler may choose ready background/sprite IDs and semantic movement/expression only. It delegates all chat/provider behavior to the existing ChatService.
